title: Race rehearsal brought forward: 3 x 470m sustained climbs
terrain: forested to open, 3 x ~470m D+, total D+ ~1400m, D- ~1400m in three separate bouts, non-technical descent line, no exposed crest

steps.target: Z2-Z3 sustained climb, 84-89% LTHR, ~470m D+ continuous

coachNotes: RAISED 155 -> 185, D+ 1000 -> 1400, ON THE ATHLETE'S CALL. Gate 2 passed: lateral knee completely clean this morning, 48h after Wednesday's 1206m descent, which is the window in which a developing band problem announces itself. Both gates green, so the day goes. WHY THREE CLIMBS AND NOT TWO BIGGER ONES: the ITB reacts to the length of a continuous eccentric bout, not to the day's descent total. Three ~470m descents with a climb between each is a materially different stress from two 700m ones, and the same total metres. No single descent bout goes over ~470m. If the terrain only offers one long line down, the day is 2 x 470m and you go home at 940m, the bout cap outranks the volume target. WHY NOT 2000m: Wednesday was 1206m of descent three days ago and it was your first in 17 days. Adding 2000m makes 3200m inside four days off a cold band, which is the shape of late February, not a rehearsal. 1400m is +16% on Wednesday, inside the 15-20% descent ramp rule. EFFORT IS DELIBERATELY LOWER THAN THE 2x500 VERSION: 84-89% LTHR on the climbs, not 88-93%. This is race climbing effort. At Pirin you will not climb 3300m at Z3, so rehearsing at Z3 rehearses the wrong thing. If the third climb is a grind, that is the session working. THE ROUTE IS THE CAP, NOT YOUR DISCIPLINE. You went 27% over on 19 August because you felt good, which is the honest reason and the most common one. Pick the three-lap or three-spur line tonight, load it, and finish where the GPX finishes. No fourth climb, no summit out-and-back. TERRAIN: 65-107mm fell Thursday and Friday so limestone will be soaked. No exposed crest, no cable sections, no polished slab, no steep step-down braking terrain. Forested or grassy, runnable at cadence 175+ even wet. FUELLING REHEARSAL, this is now the main one and not a side benefit: eat every 40 minutes from the first climb, race products only, 60-90g carbs/hour, 2 x 500ml minimum, write down what you actually took. You are on your feet ~4h30, which is the first honest look at what your stomach does at hour four. ELECTRICAL STORM FALLBACK: abort to the valley on the first thunder and finish flat, do not wait it out under the tree line. AMBER OVERRIDE: any lateral knee signal in the warm-up and it is 1 x 470m plus flat, load 110, no negotiation. Garmin expect 300-360.
